elements.element: IBM must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires IBM to maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: IBM must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: IBM must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If IBM processes Customer Data, IBM must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where IBM processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed on behalf of Customer. This encompasses processing Customer Data and the agreement expressly contemplates IBM processing personal information on Customer's behalf.

elements.element: IBM must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

result.reason: The operative insurance provision fully satisfies the preferred position and therefore also the fallback. It is not minimal because unrelated existing paragraphs were reordered, and the cyber-insurance trigger was drafted more broadly than the requested Customer Data trigger. The insurance language itself is clear and complete, but the rendered redline unnecessarily rearranges unrelated text.
